jobs.title: Junior Backend Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Lumen Ledger is hiring a junior backend engineer to build Node.js and TypeScript services for its reconciliation platform.
jobs.description:
Lumen Ledger builds reconciliation and month-end close software for small finance teams, used by accountants at 20-200 person companies who are done matching bank lines in spreadsheets. The company is a remote team of 34 across EMEA and South Asia and is hiring its second junior backend engineer.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain Node.js and TypeScript services that import bank feeds and match transactions to invoices.
  • Write PostgreSQL migrations and tune the matching engine's queries.
  • Ship small, tested changes to production several times a week with senior review.
  • Join a light daytime support rotation once settled.

Must have

  • 1+ year of professional backend work in Node.js with TypeScript.
  • Comfort with SQL and relational modelling, ideally PostgreSQL.
  • Clear written English.
  • Four hours of overlap with 09:00-17:00 CET.

Nice to have

  • Docker and Docker Compose; some AWS (RDS, ECS or Lambda); interest in accounting or payments.

Fully remote within UTC-1 to UTC+6. USD 28,000-36,000 per year via employer of record, plus a learning budget and home-office stipend.

jobs.title: Backend Developer (Node.js)
jobs.excerpt: Fernhill Logistics is looking for a Backend Developer to build Node.js routing services for its last-mile delivery fleet.
jobs.description:
Fernhill Logistics runs last-mile delivery for grocery chains in the Benelux. We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our routing team of eight engineers, who work mostly asynchronously.

What you'll do

  • Build Node.js and TypeScript services that plan delivery routes for 600 vans a day.
  • Maintain our PostgreSQL and Redis data layer.
  • Integrate with telematics providers and our driver app.
  • Monitor services in production and improve alerting.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience with Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Good SQL skills and experience with PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with message queues (RabbitMQ or SQS).

Nice to have

  • Experience with routing or optimisation problems.
  • Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Dutch.

What we offer

Remote within Europe and nearby time zones (UTC-1 to UTC+4), EUR 45,000-55,000 per year, 26 days of leave and a yearly team trip. This posting was first published in August and may already be filled.
